content: Ha Hafelehmi Irel Yodla Be Budoh Samol
Hami rewol bismem, tayor pelal le ibe teftafwey babior iremi le kofael rala yebe weldoh meka iyang.
Hami ngo hasa gola le yodla Samol yebe budoh ila si towe dap iyang, bo yebe wochog yal budoh semal cho machoh llubong.

Irel yodla yarmat rebe sor bo, “Pangal formel ngo sa pos ngo tayor mele be wel”, iwe ngo towe ssulay ngo be holar hagerger! Yebe ttir yal budoh le be wochog ttiril yael semal fefel bbareg irel mala bele dimolow, ngo tor semal le be ddar tang hagerger le.
Iwe ngo hami rewol bismem, ila hate mel luwul ruchupung. Ila hatowe lluwdah le be wochog yal lluwdah semal cho machoh irel yodla bela budoh Ralla.
Pangmi ngo hami yarmetael luwul teram le hami yarmetael lerral. Te gich yarmetael llubong hare yarmetael luwul ruchupung.
Ila gich si towe masor le sibe wochog ikla sibis, bo gich sibe mmat ngo ye medaf lal depach.
Llubong mele yarmat rema masor iyang, iwe ngo wol llubong mele rema belas iyang.

Iwe ngo gich ila yarmetael lerral, le yebe medaf lal depach. Sibe yetedah tugul mo hachangcheng uwoch, le be wochog madpil parang we sedep we saldaw rema itol lal wuber. Iwe ngo yach luglug irel molow ila sibe yetedah uwoch le be wochog cholfechal fedeg kowe yar saldaw.
Deus yete hatugulu gich bo sibe hafohoy irel ssong la yal, bo far mala be yoh le sibe daor irel Samol la yach Jesus Kristus.
Ye mes bo fael mala sibe dabey irel molow, le te tugul hare si chil molow, hare siya mes irel yodla yebe budoh iyang.
Ila sibe hakkela depel semal mo semal gich ngo si tipingi fengaligich le be wochog mala hami ha foforu igla.
Hartael Hapatpat Mo Habong
Hami rewol bismem, ha kakafael pechehmi bo habe hasrowur rechokla re ye yengang luwulumi, le re tutupungugmi ngo re fofoloyu ngalugmi mekla wegdegel Kristiano.
Ha hasrowur ngo ha kewar ngalir lepal yami hachangir bo fael yengang kala rema foru. Habe mel le be pos llepdami.

Hami rewol bismem, ha kakafael pechehmi bo habe hapatpat ngalir rechokla re tahayreg le tor mele rema foru, ngo hasa hakkela deper rechokla re ha motog ngo ha tipingir ikla re tayikel, ngo ha malulu ngal pangal yarmat.
Habe kemahoy bo semal de palili tayikof ngal tayikof. Iwe ngo ha yedamgili habe foru le pangal yad, ngo habe ma foru mekla ye momay ngal semal mo semal hami, ngo ha wol foru ngalir panger yarmat.
Pangal yad ngo habe ma rraey,
ngo pangal yad ngo habe ma mapel,
ngo pangal yad ngo habe ma kangalu Deus yal hachigchig irel pangal meka yema holahmi. Iye mele Deus ye dipli bo habe ma foru irel molow le hasa mel iyang le hasa sew chog mo Kristus Jesus.
Ha towe pilta Espritu Santus tangugmi,
ngo ha towe tolpagili meka yalol Espritu Santus le semal ye kapta.
Pangal formel ngo habe ma hagela: ha hasi ikla ye momay, ngo
hasa hachuyaloh pangal ikla ye tayikof mo iremi.
Deus le yema fang hopos yebe fahohmi, ngo ye forugmi bo habe santus ngo ye foru mekla holongmi mo ngulmi bo yebe taldag mo irel pangal tayikof irel yodla yebe budoh Samol Jesus Kristus.
Yeramtala ye ffesangugmi mele yebe foru mele bo fael mala yema foru mekla yesa hatugulu bo yebe foru.
Hami rewol bismem, habe wol mapelahmem.
Panger rechokla resa chepar ngo habe ma fang ngalir hagilel hopos.
Ibe kangalugmi irel mala idel Samol bo habe yawli babior le ngalir rechokla resa chepar.
Haradiya la yael Samol la yach Jesus Kristus be mel iremi.
